_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: no range break, funding flat, and momentum still 40-60, so stay on the Hope rung until a confirmed breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/CAUTION in Hope; narrative is flow-positive but silent on phase/direction, so split resolved toward analyst
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G 55-70, 30d momentum 40-60, price rangebound, funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum exits 40-60 on range break with ETF/funding lift (up into Optimism) or F&G <55 plus long liquidation (down into Disbelief)
